summary: Current D5 remains the fixed managed consumer of canonical Coordination owner ac222065/source d846dbe1: the executor, literal unshare --user --map-root-user --net -- /usr/bin/true argv, cleared LANG/TZ environment, NNP, Ubuntu24 host, source/product roles, rehearsal/full distinction, resource floors, first-step2100s/unit1800s/stop5s and original phase clocks are unchanged. The first genuine D5 attempt failed at a UID-map write before SDK acquisition; observed NNP1 and a host-image hash do not establish the denial cause. That original failure is distinct from BAR pasta proc-access failure. Missing child UID/maps/caps/dumpability/LSM evidence must remain Unknown. The successor source now resets ADMISSION=None before dependency imports/effects; the old selection and UTC cutoff are historical, not a reusable grant or renewed clock. A fresh successor still needs root selection plus exact reviewed/delivered source and new original clocks. Before the existing literal probe, a closed optional five-second read-only collector observes the current D5 parent identity, proc status selected UID/GID/capability/NNP/seccomp fields, UID/GID maps, namespace and proc ownership, GET_DUMPABLE/GET_SECUREBITS, fixed LSM labels/restriction state, kernel/boot and bounded unshare image hash/mode/file-capability metadata. It spawns no process and changes no syscall policy, sysctl, credentials, namespace, caps, dumpability, host or backend. Parent state is explicitly not post-exec/post-CLONE child state and cannot identify the cause by itself. Missing, inaccessible, expired or raced observations are Unknown; no-denial evidence is not LSM absence. The optional payload is limited to128KiB and serialized with nonfinite rejection inside its exception boundary before becoming part of the canonical attempt JSON. Thus optional read or overflow failure remains secondary and cannot skip the original probe, raw stderr, canonical collection/terminal evidence or always-upload route. Unshare reads are bounded, reject final-file symlinks and require complete stable image bytes; a binary hash does not invent its util-linux version. Static actual-entry controls were chosen over a model: normal/missing/exception/oversize/NaN/valid-JSON1e999 cases preserve the original failed probe and original stream bytes through the actual bounded copier, terminal record and manifest. Additional inert fixtures cover closed fields, partial permission errors, expired original clocks, read/symlink/image bounds and changed image refusal. Thirty focused D5 controls plus two held DOM dependency/import controls pass without unshare, libc prctl, SDK, Node/CLR, owner runtime, acquisition or native workload. The held DOM consumer changes only its D5 helper hash because it imports unchanged collection. No runtime diagnosis, host alternative qualification, descendant retirement, full matrix or whole4849/4644 acceptance follows from these source controls.
